# Doremi Road: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 4291c15d30bb · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A piano-learning game: play notes, chords and progressions on a MIDI keyboard, computer keys or touch screen, train your ear and conquer the Realm of Harmony.
**Live:** https://doremiroad.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/doremiroad · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `doremiroad/.claude/skills/doremiroad/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py doremiroad` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on 2026-11-08 (branch `forms`).** The engines moved unchanged into theme/assets:
  `dr-core.js` (DR.Sound synth, DR.Input = MIDI + computer keys + touch, DR.settings), `dr-music.js` (theory, must
  match server_code/Music.py), `dr-art.js` (map, crests, medallions, title scene), `dr-engine.js` (DR.Keyboard,
  DR.Stage: every step type, scoring, rush highway). `dr-ui.js` holds what used to sit inside the old pages' scripts:
  the Practice Room engine (`DR.UI.practice`), codex example keyboard, shop previews and the editor's checks /
  summaries / previews / hear (`DR.Admin`, same rules as Levels.check).
- Python reaches the engines only through `client_code/dr.py`; game state lives in `client_code/game.py` (`game.S`,
  guest progress in localStorage `dr.guest`, guest_* server twins). Result checking stays on the server.
- Addresses: the old app had only "" and #admin; the hub tabs are now #map, #codex, #collection, #practice,
  #badges, #shop, a level is #play/<key> (#play/daily). #landing/how jumps to How to play.
- Sign-in moved from a modal to the template's #auth page (sign-up name optional); after sign-in
  `game.signed_in()` imports the guest progress (import_guest) as before.
- Gotchas: a `role` on a custom HTML-form component (Keys, Art) is not applied on the App Server: wrap it in a div
  with a class. Shell hides its header on #landing (`no-header`) and everything on #play (`no-chrome`; the Stage is
  position: fixed). Results/Pause/Fail are alert() dialogs opened from the Stage's events.
- Dark only (no light theme): the --c-* tokens are the old --dr-* palette; the engines still read --dr-*.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **levels**: key:str, territory→territories, name:str, position:num, data:obj, published:bool, updated:dt, builtin:bool, clears:num · used in Admin, Game

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
